findings.F1: Subsumed same-effect/same-cost facts preserve Final, task closure, zero reservation, resolved obligations and capacity; new cost and contradictions still dispute.
findings.F2: Existing workflow ownership gates generic outbox claims and common send admission. Executed Send intent and attempt commit atomically; crash, concurrency and reload regressions pass.
findings.F3: Independent 19-digit cumulative domain covers two 18-digit request components; authenticated receipt and crash recovery settle legal aggregates.
findings.F4: Memory replay normalizes against the historical contract and checks the full submission digest; new runs still require the active contract.
